arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, and it's great that your contact email is clearly listed. One suggestion: the site is quite minimal right now — adding a short bio, a photo, and maybe some info about what you do would make it feel much more personal and engaging. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's lovely that you share your passion for hiking — that's a great topic with lots of potential. A suggestion: adding some photos from your hikes, trail details, or stories from specific trips would really bring it to life and keep readers coming back. Happy hiking!
